title: icacorea copeyana
intro: Icacorea copeyana, commonly known as Copay, is a plant species found in the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Copay include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Copay include alkaloids, saponins, and other compounds that have shown potential in reducing inflammation and fighting off pathogens.
